experiment: E211 (realistic_tasks run 2), cell P2.38 run 2: every scorecard method on the three real-text pairs run 1 kept, each side trained to two matched update sizes, three seeds, zero and Gaussian controls

definitions.pairs: reuse side first: L1 (AG News Sports vs Business label after ' Topic:') vs L3 (the same texts, a seeded coin label); T2 (French Wikipedia) vs T3 (Yoruba Wikipedia, run 1's filed choice); T1 (E53's lowercase Pile rows) vs T4 (Pile rows with each sentence's words reversed). Sides as run 1 labelled them by their data argument; no verdict of reused or new
definitions.size: ||dW|| / ||W0|| over the 24 decomposed matrices, Frobenius norms summed in squares (E187's; realistic.update_size). Each fine-tune is saved at the first step its size reaches each target, no interpolation
definitions.units: lo: log-odds of each row's target over the whole vocabulary (the share's unit). contrast (label tasks only): logit of the row's label minus the other label's (E140's unit). The label pair is scored in contrast, lo beside (decisions.md 2026-11-18 'Label tasks scored on the two-label contrast'); the LM pairs in lo
definitions.read rows: L1 and L3: the 512 training-pool texts (same tokens, labels differ; L3 is defined only there), the label read at the marker's last position; each label task's held-out 512 texts give 'held_gain' beside. T1: E53's 500 scored windows (E136's read). T2, T3, T4: 500 windows of 127 tokens from the 64 held rows, the scored token at index 64: in each row the 8 word-start positions of lowest W0 log-odds of the true token, then the 500 lowest of those (realistic.hard_positions, W0 only, fixed before any fine-tune)
definitions.fitting windows (steering): L: the 512 pool texts. T1: E53's 2,000 hand-write windows (E143's). T2-T4: the same position rule on training rows 0-255, 2,000 windows
definitions.readings: commute.realistic_reads: gain T1 - T0 (fp32); prior T0 (W0); share (L01 - L00)/(T1 - T0) on the released decomposition, do-nothing form; untrained the same on W0's SVD (scored) and its rotation (beside), E136's k_m; neuron (N01 - N00)/gain with TopK firing, k 64 (scored) and k matched (beside); steering pooled fair steering, setting picked in the scored unit on 512 fitting windows; k_half E98's count in the scored unit; erank (update_spectrum); size. Every share is nan when its gain is under 1 (MIN_GAIN)
definitions.call: realistic.seed_call, the scorecard's one rule (method_table/plot_final.py score): nan or null values left out; 'apart' iff the two sides' seed ranges do not overlap, else 'no call'; one value a side (the prior) gets 'one value a side' and its filed direction is judged on the gap's sign; gap = reuse mean - new mean, log10(reuse/new) for size and erank, log10(new/reuse) for k_half (positive = fewer neurons on the reuse side). Under no difference, 3 seeds a side read 'apart' by chance 0.1 of the time per cell, so about 2 chance calls are expected over 3 pairs x 2 sizes x 9 readings; a method is read on its direction across pairs, not on one cell
definitions.card call: score2.py with realistic.rival on the share's calls: rival a when, at both sizes, both LM pairs read apart with the reuse side higher and the label pair's gap is not negative; rival b when at the larger size at least two of the three pairs read no call, unreadable or apart the other way; else between

control.ctl job (alone, first): E53 lowercase_s0 and cipher_s0 through realistic_reads reproduce: share 0.75188 / 0.12431 (tol 0.01: the masked_reads path batches 64, E136 read at 32), untrained svd 0.11846 / 0.06767 and rotated 0.32811 / 0.17909 (1e-4, the same calls), gain 1.67213 / 3.86808 (1e-4), neuron k64 0.03414 / 0.00489 and k matched 0.00777 / 0.00096 (1e-4), pooled steering 0.71306 / 0.69298 (1e-3), erank 598.5738 / 594.2662 (1e-6); lowercase_s0's k_half 16 exactly and r_half numerator 0.87998 (1e-4); a zero update on T1's rows reads every numerator and gain exactly 0. Any miss exits 1 before any task job
control.zero update (first in every task job): every gain and numerator exactly 0 (share, untrained, neuron, steering rise, k_half's r_half numerator), else exit 1; then every share nan, k_half null, erank null, size 0
control.Gaussian (3 draws per size, seed 0's per: size equal to seed 0's state at that target within 1e-5 relative; gain in the scored unit under 1, else exit 1 (expected -1.5 to +0.3); every share nan (gain under the floor); k_half null; erank above every trained state's of the same task and size (expected 650 to 760: a Gaussian matrix's singular values are near equal; E53's trained states read 573-600)
control.W0 (prior, the same at every state): L1 contrast +1 to +3 (W0 labels 93% of held texts right, run 1 stage1 w0_accuracy 0.932); L3 contrast within 0.3 of 0 (coin independent of the text); lo: L1 about -7.4, L3 about -8.8 (run 1's first-step label losses 7.41 and 8.82); T1 lo -6.75 +- 0.1 (E53: state -5.08 minus gain 1.672); T2, T3, T4 lo -9 to -16 (the lowest word starts of each row), T2 above T3

expected.gain at the larger size, scored unit: L1 contrast 3 to 6; L3 contrast 1.5 to 6 (pool texts, memorised coins); T1 1.65 +- 0.05 (E53 1.672 at size 0.01795); T2 0.5 to 3 (may fall under 1: T2's shares then read nan, reported as read); T3 1.5 to 5; T4 2 to 6. At the smaller size 50% to 85% of these
expected.held_gain (beside): L3 contrast within 0.3 of 0 at both sizes (a coin does not carry to unseen texts); L1 contrast over 1
expected.steps to size: L1 about 280 to 0.010 (under the cap 600), L3 about 80; T1 285 to 300, T2 about 200, T3 and T4 about 120-150 to 0.0175

edge_cases_checked_before_filing: tests/test_realistic.py: seed_call leaves nan and null out and reads a side with none 'unreadable', one 'one value a side'; equal range ends overlap (no call); a ratio over a non-positive mean gives gap nan, judged 'unreadable' by filed; k_half's gap is log10(new/reuse); filed reads 'none' as a hit only on no call; rival needs both LM pairs apart upward and reads a nan label gap as not rival a; hard_positions skips nan, non-word starts and windows that leave the row, caps each row, breaks ties by row then position, and raises with too few candidates; cut_windows puts the scored token at index half + 1; the contrast readout equals E140's
seen_before_filing: run 1's stage0-2 results (E209), E53's, E136's, E140's, E143's and E98's saved readings named above; no state of this run
